narr: An unstable southwest flow aloft, combined with a strong jet stream aloft and a moist low-level easterly flow, resulted in numerous severe thunderstorms across the Billings Forecast Area. These thunderstorms contained large hail and very heavy rain.
ev: County DES reported deep standing water and flooding in the town of Baker.
lsr: FALLON COUNTY DES REPORTS DEEP STANDING WATER AND FLOODING IN BAKER.
